source: Excel 16 CalculateFullRebuild on temporary copies of both original XLSM files

classification.EXACT: Excel Value2 decimal representation equals the exact rational, or text values match exactly
classification.NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT: Reserved for separately proven algebraic equality; not inferred from IEEE-754 coincidence
classification.DISPLAY_MATCH: Excel Value2 and exact rational display the same under source NumberFormat; internal values may differ
classification.MISMATCH: Source NumberFormat display or text differs
classification.UNVERIFIED: Unavailable or incomparable Excel value, with reason
